requiredRuntimeSemantics: The predicate must identify the first qualifying committed Cove gunpowder or pirate ranged volley/action in the relevant battle or round window.
First-volley state must be correlated to the acting unit, gunpowder/pirate classifier, Focus or reload companion predicate, active Cove law owner, and committed action timing.
The law must not become a passive all-ranged bonus or trigger from generic ranged attacks after the first qualifying volley has been consumed.
forbiddenSubstitutes: passive all-ranged bonus counted as first volley
any ranged attack counted as first volley without first-action state
battle start counted as first volley
round start counted as first volley
shooter role counted as gunpowder first volley
Cove faction membership counted as first volley
Focus or reload config counted without committed action proof

requiredRuntimeSemantics: The predicate must observe committed Focus generation, Focus spend, or Focus-consuming Pirate/Cannon ranged attack semantics for the Cove law owner.
Focus event timing must be correlated to battle lifecycle context, Focus recipient or spender, active Cove law owner, and Storm Omens calendar reward timing.
Hero energy pool existence, Focus UI values, side energy payloads, or generic ranged attacks are only context and cannot stand in for a committed Focus event.
forbiddenSubstitutes: hero energy pool existence counted as Focus event
Focus UI value counted as committed Focus event
side energy payload counted without recipient and ordering proof
any ranged attack counted as Focus event
battle start counted as Focus generation
passive all-ranged bonus counted as Focus event
Cove faction membership counted as Focus event

requiredRuntimeSemantics: The predicate must observe a committed Stronghold Warcry execution or explicit Rage tempo event derived from the law packet's damage-taken and kill/loss companion events.
Rage state must be correlated to the acting or affected Stronghold unit, companion damage/kill event, active Stronghold law owner, and safe buff/tempo application point.
Morale animations, generic morale packages, static Warcry ownership, hero ability config, or ordinary spell cooldown state cannot stand in for a committed Warcry or Rage event.
forbiddenSubstitutes: morale animation counted as Warcry or Rage event
generic morale package counted as Rage event
static Warcry skill ownership counted as Warcry execution
hero ability config counted as Warcry execution
damage event counted as Rage without companion ordering proof
kill event counted as Rage without companion ordering proof
Stronghold faction membership counted as Warcry or Rage event
